title: Samsung Upgrades Interactive Display to Auto-Convert Lessons Into Text
snippet: Samsung Electronics introduced new AI features for its educational interactive display at ISTE Live 26 in Orlando, including auto-transcription,
extractedText: Samsung Upgrades Interactive Display to Auto-Convert Lessons Into TextJoins Largest North American Education Technology Expo Adds 'Samsung AI Assistant' Features Draw a Circle on the Board to Search ImagesFinance|Published 2026.06.29. 11:00:05|By Kim Yoon-soo|Summary|SaveAAAA Samsung Electronics official introduces new educational solutions for interactive whiteboards at "ISTE Live 26," the largest education technology exhibition in North America, held at the Orange County Convention Center (OCCC) in Orlando, Florida, on the 28th (local time). Photo courtesy of Samsung ElectronicsSamsung Electronics (005930.KS) has introduced new features for its educational interactive display that automatically convert lesson content into text for recording and support easy image searches.Samsung Electronics said it unveiled its educational solutions for interactive displays at "ISTE Live 26," the largest education technology expo in North America, held at the Orange County Convention Center (OCCC) in Orlando, Florida, on Sunday.Samsung Electronics has embedded the "Samsung AI Assistant" into the interactive display to help teachers improve lesson focus and increase interaction with students. The Samsung AI Assistant features "Circle to Search," which finds and provides related information or content when a circle is drawn around an image or text on the screen, and "Automatic Transcription," which converts a teacher's voice into text in real time.The Samsung AI Assistant also offers "AI Summary," which automatically summarizes lesson content, and "AI Quiz," which enhances learning comprehension. In particular, Automatic Transcription supports not only students with hearing impairments but also multiple languages, which is expected to greatly improve educational accessibility so that students from multicultural families are not left out. AI Quiz also helps check students' comprehension in real time by having AI generate quizzes based on the actual lesson content delivered.Samsung Electronics has also strengthened security on its interactive display by adding the "Samsung Account Management Solution," which allows teachers to log in easily and securely via QR codes or NFC cards. When teaching across multiple classrooms, teachers can load their personalized home screen and learning materials."As digital education environments become more advanced, innovation centered on the 'user experience,' not just devices, is essential," said Kim Hyung-jae, Executive Vice President of Samsung Electronics' Visual Display (VD) Business. "With Samsung's educational interactive displays, we aim to provide a more flexible and seamless learning environment for both teachers and students."#Samsung#EdTech#InteractiveDisplay#SamsungAI#ISTE2026#DigitalEducation#AIAssistantCompanies in this storySamsung Electronics005930.KS · SemiconductorAI KEY Company Analysis →Original reporting by Kim Yoon-soo for Seoul Economic Daily.AI-translated from Korean.
